title: Kitab Ghar MERN Application Homepage & Visual Identity
purpose: Initial render of the integrated full MERN application homepage.
what_it_demonstrates: React 18 SPA homepage connected to the Express backend and MongoDB database, rendering live trust metrics, brand identity, and the Book Genie hero.

title: Interactive Book Genie Recommendation Engine
purpose: Interactive Akinator-style recommendation wizard querying live catalogue.
what_it_demonstrates: React recommendation wizard querying the 77-book MongoDB catalogue via Express API to provide real-time personalized book suggestions.

title: Full-Stack Books Catalogue Route (/books)
purpose: Live API-backed catalogue rendering 77 books directly from MongoDB.
what_it_demonstrates: React BooksPage component querying Express /api/books with URLSearchParams, live search input, category filters, and availability toggles.

title: Dynamic Book Details & Rental Cart Action (/books/:id)
purpose: Dynamic parameter route fetching record details via Mongoose findById.
what_it_demonstrates: Targeted book record loaded from MongoDB via Express /api/books/:id, displaying cover art, description, real-time inventory count, and rental cart interaction.

title: Subscription Management & UPI Payment Gateway (/membership)
purpose: Live reader subscription tiers with dynamic UPI payment integration.
what_it_demonstrates: Subscription tiers retrieved from MongoDB /api/plans rendered into interactive cards with dynamic UPI QR code modal generation.

title: Full-Stack Reader Authentication & JWT Session (/login)
purpose: Controlled reader login screen interacting with /api/auth/login.
what_it_demonstrates: Controlled login form transmitting credentials to the Express authController, verifying bcrypt password hashes against MongoDB, and storing JWT tokens.

title: Protected Reader Dashboard & Account Overview (/dashboard)
purpose: Guarded reader dashboard displaying authenticated profile and rentals.
what_it_demonstrates: Protected reader dashboard guarded by React ProtectedRoute and Express JWT middleware, rendering live account details and library services.

title: Responsive Mobile Full MERN Layout (320px)
purpose: Mobile responsiveness verification at 320px viewport width.
what_it_demonstrates: Complete MERN application UI and Book Genie hero adapting cleanly to a 320px mobile viewport without horizontal scrolling or clipping.
